name: dentist-app
description: Offline LAN dental practice management — run scripts

scripts.install:all: pnpm --dir backend install && pnpm --dir frontend install
scripts.build: pnpm --dir frontend build && pnpm --dir backend build
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "pnpm --dir backend start:dev" "pnpm --dir frontend dev"
scripts.start: pnpm run build && pnpm --dir backend start:prod
